geography: World Bank countries and economies with a non-aggregate region and at least one published value in the series. Codes follow the World Bank registry, including XKX for Kosovo.
transformations: Rows are grouped under their source economy codes. All years within the observed series span appear. Null in JSON and blank in CSV represent an unavailable observation. Numeric values retain the precision returned by the publisher. Explicit zeros and status codes are retained.
validation: Every API value and missing cell was checked against the separate official CSV. For residuals below 1e-14 percent in magnitude, some CSV decimals have additional digits. They must match exactly when rounded to the last decimal published in the API. The records use the API value and the series metadata lists both original decimals for each difference.

partner-group-high-income-exports.name: Merchandise exports to high-income economies (% of total merchandise exports)
partner-group-high-income-exports.definition: Merchandise exports to high-income economies are the sum of merchandise exports from the reporting economy to high-income economies according to the World Bank classification of economies. Data are expressed as a percentage of total merchandise exports by the economy. Data are computed only if at least half of the economies in the partner country group had non-missing data.
partner-group-high-income-exports.sourceOrganizations:
Staff estimates, World Bank (WB);
Direction of Trade database, International Monetary Fund (IMF)

partner-group-high-income-imports.name: Merchandise imports from high-income economies (% of total merchandise imports)
partner-group-high-income-imports.definition: Merchandise imports from high-income economies are the sum of merchandise imports by the reporting economy from high-income economies according to the World Bank classification of economies. Data are expressed as a percentage of total merchandise imports by the economy. Data are computed only if at least half of the economies in the partner country group had non-missing data.
partner-group-high-income-imports.sourceOrganizations:

Direction of Trade database, International Monetary Fund (IMF)

partner-group-residual-exports.name: Merchandise exports by the reporting economy, residual (% of total merchandise exports)
partner-group-residual-exports.definition: Merchandise exports by the reporting economy residuals are the total merchandise exports by the reporting economy to the rest of the world as reported in the IMF's Direction of trade database, less the sum of exports by the reporting economy to high-, low-, and middle-income economies according to the World Bank classification of economies. Includes trade with unspecified partners or with economies not covered by World Bank classification. Data are as a percentage of total merchandise exports by the economy.
partner-group-residual-exports.sourceOrganizations:
Staff estimates, World Bank (WB);
Direction of Trade database, International Monetary Fund (IMF)

partner-group-residual-imports.name: Merchandise imports by the reporting economy, residual (% of total merchandise imports)
partner-group-residual-imports.definition: Merchandise imports by the reporting economy residuals are the total merchandise imports by the reporting economy from the rest of the world as reported in the IMF's Direction of trade database, less the sum of imports by the reporting economy from high-, low-, and middle-income economies according to the World Bank classification of economies. Includes trade with unspecified partners or with economies not covered by World Bank classification. Data are as a percentage of total merchandise imports by the economy.
partner-group-residual-imports.sourceOrganizations:
Staff estimates, World Bank (WB);
Direction of Trade database, International Monetary Fund (IMF)

partner-group-within-region-exports.name: Merchandise exports to low- and middle-income economies within region (% of total merchandise exports)
partner-group-within-region-exports.definition: Merchandise exports to low- and middle-income economies within region are the sum of merchandise exports from the reporting economy to other low- and middle-income economies in the same World Bank region as a percentage of total merchandise exports by the economy. Data are computed only if at least half of the economies in the partner country group had non-missing data. No figures are shown for high-income economies, because they are a separate category in the World Bank classification of economies.

Data are as a percentage of total merchandise imports by the economy. Data are computed only if at least half of the economies in the partner country group had non-missing data. No figures are shown for high-income economies, because they are a separate category in the World Bank classification of economies.

methodology.source: International Monetary Fund Direction of Trade Statistics and World Bank staff estimates, distributed in World Development Indicators.
methodology.measure: Maps show the reporting economy. The selected partners are destinations of merchandise exports or origins of merchandise imports. Shares divide by all merchandise trade in that direction for the reporting economy.
methodology.coverage: For the high-income and low- and middle-income partner groups, WDI requires data for at least half of the partner economies. Missing source observations stay unavailable.
methodology.classification: The low- and middle-income groups are relative to the reporting economy’s region. WDI describes an exclusion of high-income reporters for within-region figures, but its published files include values for some, including Japan. All direct observations are retained.
methodology.residual: The published residual is total world trade less the flows assigned to partner income groups, including unspecified or unclassified partners. Tiny negative residuals are retained as reported.
